peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 4.1% above its local comparables; 38 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (12.1): 2.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 10 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 1991.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,330,000 ($1,236 psf, 1,076 sq ft; 5 resales, Jul 2025–Jun 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,150 psf (range $1,027–1,348); 7.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $93,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,535,000 ($1,218 psf, 1,227–1,388 sq ft; 16 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,209 psf (range $1,080–1,438); 0.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $11,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Chinese Garden MRT about 230 m, Lakeside MRT about 1,300 m; closer than 68 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Jurong Primary School about 470 m; more than 62 of 94 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 280 m), more than 22 of 94 similar developments (the same as 12); nearest hawker centre Yuhua Market And Hawker Centre about 230 m; nearest park Chinese Gardens about 510 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 4 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Lakegarden Residences, 61 new sales, about 1,240 m; Sora, 41 new sales, about 1,410 m; J'Den, 9 new sales, about 1,420 m; Tengah Garden Residences, 863 new sales, about 1,800 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 25 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,089 new sales and 297 resales (1,386 purchases); new sales were 78.6% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Lucerne Grand (launch, under construction), about 1,470 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 297 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 26 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 297 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 318 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.6%). Planning-area private resales 0%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
